commonMistakes: Assuming every pharmacy offers every NHS service
serviceExplanations: NMS supports patients starting selected new medicines with structured follow-up from the pharmacy.
Follow-up helps identify problems early and improves adherence.
NHS pharmacy clinical services offer convenient access for selected conditions without always needing a GP appointment.
New Medicine Service is delivered by qualified pharmacy teams following clinical governance.
Support for patients starting selected new medicines to improve adherence.
authorityStatements: NMS is an NHS service designed to improve outcomes for new medicine starters.
Participating pharmacies follow NHS service specifications and PGDs where applicable.
Community pharmacies can provide convenient access to new medicine service where commissioned or clinically appropriate.
contentAvoid: Do not claim NMS for all medicines
Do not replace prescriber for dose changes
Do not claim universal NHS availability
Do not replace GP or emergency care
